verdict.rationale: Scheduling jobs on managed infrastructure is a fair question for a GPU cloud, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions a managed Slurm or Kubernetes offering. Overlay networks for multi-node instances and Vast Serverless are adjacent capabilities, not a managed cluster scheduler, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can schedule jobs on managed Slurm or Kubernetes instead of building my own scheduler on raw nodes
